ATRIUM.gloss: any chamber that is connected to other chambers or passageways
ATRIUM.definition: Any chamber that is connected to other chambers or passageways (especially one of the two upper chambers of the heart).

TRIM.gloss: remove the edges from and cut down to the desired size
TRIM.definition: Remove the edges from and cut down to the desired size.

MART.gloss: an area in a town where a public mercantile establishment is set up
MART.definition: An area in a town where a public mercantile establishment is set up.

TRAM.gloss: a conveyance that transports passengers or freight in carriers suspended from cables…
TRAM.definition: A conveyance that transports passengers or freight in carriers suspended from cables and supported by a series of towers.

AMIR.definition: An independent ruler or chieftain (especially in Africa or Arabia).

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

ART.definition: The products of human creativity; works of art collectively.

ARM.definition: A human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

RAM.gloss: strike or drive against with a heavy impact
RAM.definition: Strike or drive against with a heavy impact.
RAM.example: Ram the gate with a sledgehammer.

RAT.gloss: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
RAT.definition: Any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse.

ATM.definition: A unit of pressure: the pressure that will support a column of mercury 760 mm high at sea level and 0 degrees centigrade.

RIM.gloss: the shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object
RIM.definition: The shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).

MAT.gloss: a thick flat pad used as a floor covering
MAT.definition: A thick flat pad used as a floor covering.
